newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks end firm as bourse out of doldrums.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks end firm as bourse out of doldrums.

text.p: Shares on the Tallinn stock exchange stayed active on Monday, picking up on last week's rally to close higher amid good volume, dealers said.
The Talse index rose 1.55 percent to 267.02 with 70.1 million kroons traded on the main list.
"The activity is a flow on from last week's run and it has attracted more interest to the bourse," one dealer said.
"The price movement should hold for the rest of the week with most dealers still holding orders they have not yet filled," he added.
Hoiupank saw 20.7 million kroons traded to firm slightly to 136.44, up 0.38 kroons.
"The possibility of a merger remains one of the factors affecting Hoiupank, but there is still no real substance to the comments as yet," another dealer said.
Hoiupank said on Wednesday last week that it would consider merging with another local bank.
Uhispank turned over 16 million kroons to be 0.55 kroons higher on 45.55 kroons.

Trade on the free market was 7.9 million kroons with Norma the most active at 3.9 million kroons picking up 1.80 kroons to close on 73.10 kroons after it announced a five-month profit of 52.3 million kroons.
